document.title: Your design system
cover.title:
A clear direction.
A shared foundation.
cover.text: Design system for review and approval
contents.title: A guide to the decisions
contents.text: Follow the foundations from colour and type to the components that bring them together. Select a chapter to go there.
overview.title: The design decisions working together.
overview.text: The palette, type, buttons and a card form one composition at their real sizes. The following pages explain each choice.
introduction.name: The design system
next.name: Approval
next.title: What happens next
next.text: Review the colours, type and components as one system. These decisions become the basis for implementation.
heading: Headings
label: Labels
colour.primary.job: The main colour for identity, links and strong Surfaces.
colour.secondary.job: A supporting colour for focus, accents and a second tint.
colour.tertiary.job: A third colour for an additional tint and illustration.
colour.gray.job: A quiet foundation for text, borders and neutral Surfaces.
ramp.title: {name} has a shade for every job.
ramp.text: Light shades provide backgrounds; middle shades mark edges and accents. Deep shades carry text and strong Surfaces, with every final role checked for contrast.
contrast.title: Every pairing on {name} is checked.
contrast.text: Both modes and interactive states are checked. Text needs 4.5:1; large text, focus and essential boundaries need 3:1. Decorative borders have no minimum.
surfaces-light.title: Light Surfaces keep content clear.
surfaces-light.text: Each Surface supplies its own text, link, focus and button colours. Components inherit the complete context wherever they appear.
surfaces-dark.title: Dark mode keeps the same relationships.
surfaces-dark.text: The page and tints follow the mode. Brand and inverse stay dark. All combinations are checked again.
brand-colours.title: The chosen colours and their jobs.
brand-colours.text: The brand colours keep their exact values. Grey supplies the neutral foundation. Together they generate every Surface and illustration.
typefaces.title: Six roles choose the typefaces.
typefaces.text: Text sets the main family. Other roles follow it unless a separate typeface is chosen. Each row shows the role in use.
typefaces.tuning: Typeface tuning: {features}, applied from {size} px. Both samples below are shown at 28 px.
type-scale.title: One scale keeps sizes in proportion.
type-scale.text: Eleven styles share the scale. The narrow window uses {narrow}; the wide window uses {wide}. The token identifies each size in code.
type-wide.title: Wide windows give headings room.
type-wide.text: These are the actual sizes at the widest window. The words show the relationship between levels.
type-narrow.title: Narrow windows keep the hierarchy compact.
type-narrow.text: These are the actual sizes at the narrowest window, using the same steps. Text never drops below 12 px.
labels.title: Small text gives the details a voice.
labels.text: Eyebrows and metadata share the label style. Captions and help text keep the small-text style. Every size remains on the same scale.
labels.small: A brief note that supports the main message.
spacing.title: Spacing grows with the window.
spacing.text: This design has {density} spacing. Each bar is its actual length: narrowest window above, widest below.
layout.title: Shared widths align the page.
layout.text: Wide content and the narrower reading measure share a centred rail. Side margins grow with the window. The diagram uses the same scale for every width.
corners.title: Controls and cards have related corners.
corners.text: The control radius belongs to buttons and fields; the card radius belongs to larger objects. This design is {corners}.
frame.title: A frame gives edges a deliberate weight.
frame.text: The solid frame is {width} px thick. It follows each component’s corners; field and table hairlines remain separate.
frame.off: There is no decorative frame. Fine context hairlines provide separation where needed.
shadow.title: Six elevations share one shadow style.
shadow.text: Each box shows the actual shadow for its layer. Hairlines remain visible when shadows are turned off.
shadow.off: Shadows are off. Hairlines and contrasting Surfaces separate the layers.
responsive.title: The layout adapts at 390 px.
responsive.text: Three real phone windows at 100%. The stage crops their height, as a window does; text and controls keep their actual size.
colour.name: Colour
colour.opener: A small palette becomes a complete, checked system.
typography.name: Typography
typography.opener: Typefaces and a fluid scale make the hierarchy clear.
space.name: Space and shape
space.opener: Rhythm, shape and depth bring consistency to every page.
components.name: Components
components.opener: Real components show how the decisions work together.
body-text.title: A heading introduces the reading text.
body-text.text: Heading Group combines an eyebrow, heading and deck. Body Text sets paragraphs, lists and links in the same rhythm.
heading-group.title: Heading Group introduces the subject.
heading-group.text: An eyebrow, heading and short introduction work together at different scales.
buttons.title: Buttons have three kinds and four states.
buttons.text: Filled, outline and arrow actions inherit checked colours. Each row shows four states: default, hover, focus and active.
links.title: Links keep their states on every Surface.
links.text: Links retain their meaning across Surfaces. Each row shows four states: default, hover, focus and active.
icon.title: Icons use one colour and a clear name.
icon.text: Simple one-colour marks reinforce actions without adding a separate palette.
hero-picture.title: The opening places text beside a picture.
hero-picture.text: A large geometric composition uses the design’s own palette.
hero-plate.title: The opening can use the brand Surface.
hero-plate.text: A complete brand context keeps the opening and its actions clear.
hero-typographic.title: The opening can use the display style.
hero-typographic.text: The display style creates a clear opening with generous space.
text-image.title: Text and a picture share the width.
text-image.text: The image can stand at either side; on a narrow window the parts stack in reading order.
cta-band.title: Numbers and actions make a useful ending.
cta-band.text: Key Figures pairs numbers with explanations. The CTA Band gives readers a short message and a related next step.
key-figures.title: Key Figures make important numbers visible.
key-figures.text: Large figures are paired with short explanations.
card.title: A card is a heading, a short text and a link.
card.text: Plated cards inherit their own context, frame, corners and depth.
card-unplated.title: Cards can inherit the page Surface.
card-unplated.text: Unplated cards use an image or a quiet hairline to define the opening.
card-person.title: Person cards work with or without a Surface.
card-person.text: Two cards have a tint; two inherit the page. The portraits, names and roles use the same structure.
content-card.title: Content cards add pictures and metadata.
content-card.text: Picture, metadata, heading and action keep their own accessible links.
content-row.title: Content Row makes a list easy to scan.
content-row.text: Aligned pictures, metadata and headings build a clear reading order.
card-grid.title: Card grids can use two or four columns.
card-grid.text: Two columns above and four below. The column count reduces as the cards need more room.
figure.title: Pictures and video keep their captions.
figure.text: Figure holds an image and its caption. Video Player uses the same structure with a poster and familiar controls. Both are shown at their actual size.
video-player.title: The video player starts with a poster.
video-player.text: The local poster is shown here. This offline specimen contains no video file.
embed.title: External media starts with a choice.
embed.text: The preview explains the choice before a third-party player is requested. This document loads no external media.
table.title: Table makes comparisons easy.
table.text: A plain table on the page and a striped table on brand show headings, totals and aligned digits.
table-striped.title: Table can highlight alternating rows.
table-striped.text: Alternate and hover fills retain the checked text and link colours on each Surface.
accordion.title: Accordion reveals detail when needed.
accordion.text: A hairline disclosure and a boxed disclosure reveal detail. A quotation below gives a short statement its attribution.
quotation.title: Quotation gives a statement room.
quotation.text: Attribution stays with the words, with or without a separate Surface.
callout.title: Callouts show four kinds of message.
callout.text: Four filled messages on the left; the same four outlined on the right. Words and icons identify the status alongside colour.
callout-outlined.title: Callout can use a quieter outline.
callout-outlined.text: The message inherits its ground while its mark and outline communicate the status.
content-loop.title: A content list can use cards or rows.
content-loop.text: Cards, rows and document entries use the same underlying content.
visitor-filters.title: Filters narrow a list of results.
visitor-filters.text: A typed query, topic choices and year narrow a list. The results keep their count and pagination visible.
search.title: Search results start with a query and a list.
search.text: A typed term, result count, three rows and pagination show a realistic search state.
breadcrumbs.title: A trail and pagination help navigation.
breadcrumbs.text: The trail shows the current page in its hierarchy. Pagination below moves between result pages.
table-of-contents.title: Table of Contents makes a long page easier to use.
table-of-contents.text: Links follow the page’s headings and can sit beside the main reading column.
form.title: A form combines labels, controls and help.
form.text: Visible labels, help text and specific errors support contact and subscription flows.
form-states.title: Form controls show five states.
form-states.text: Default, hover, focus, active and disabled fields keep their labels and context.
consent-banner.title: Accepting and refusing are equally easy.
consent-banner.text: Accept and reject have equal weight. Settings explain optional purposes and allow choices to be withdrawn.
consent-settings.title: Settings explain each storage purpose.
consent-settings.text: Necessary storage stays on. Optional choices begin off and can be changed separately.
footer.title: The footer combines identity, contact and links.
footer.text: The richer arrangement uses a tall identity cell beside navigation and contact details, with legal links in the final band.
footer-simple.title: Simpler footers use a single band.
footer-simple.text: A single dark band above; a light alternative below. Both keep identity and links on the same rail.
footer-light.title: Footer can stay close to the page.
footer-light.text: A light Surface and a hairline provide a quieter ending.
page.title: The page holds the bands between header and footer.
page.text: This complete composition shows the top, content and ending together, at the width of a real site.
band.title: Band gives each section a clear context.
band.text: Three bands in tint, brand and inverse share the content rail. Each Surface marks a distinct section.
reading-area.title: Reading Area keeps long text comfortable.
reading-area.text: A narrow reading column and supporting Aside share one measured layout.
header-a.title: Header arrangement A keeps navigation ordered.
header-a.text: Identity, links and actions have fixed groups that give way as the window narrows.
header-a-menu.title: The menu opens below the header.
header-a-menu.text: The open megamenu gathers navigation and supporting descriptions beneath the bar.
header-a-search.title: Search opens in its own panel.
header-a-search.text: The open search panel keeps the query, suggested links and close action together.
header-b.title: Header arrangement B keeps navigation ordered.
header-b.text: Identity, links and actions have fixed groups that give way as the window narrows.
header-b-menu.title: Header arrangement B opens a useful menu.
header-b-menu.text: The open megamenu gathers navigation and supporting descriptions beneath the bar.
header-b-search.title: Header arrangement B gives search its own space.
header-b-search.text: The open search panel keeps the query, suggested links and close action together.
header-c.title: Header arrangement C keeps navigation ordered.
header-c.text: Identity, links and actions have fixed groups that give way as the window narrows.
header-c-menu.title: Header arrangement C opens a useful menu.
header-c-menu.text: The open megamenu gathers navigation and supporting descriptions beneath the bar.
header-c-search.title: Header arrangement C gives search its own space.
header-c-search.text: The open search panel keeps the query, suggested links and close action together.
typeface-detail.title: {name} gives the words their character.
typeface-detail.text: Used for {roles}. The alphabet, figures and words below show the weights used in this design.
card-grid-two.title: Card Grid can use two columns.
card-grid-two.text: The maximum column count sets the collection’s rhythm. The grid reduces its columns when space runs out.
card-grid-four.title: Card Grid can use four columns.
card-grid-four.text: The maximum column count sets the collection’s rhythm. The grid reduces its columns when space runs out.
type-wide-detail.title: The smaller styles complete the wide hierarchy.
type-wide-detail.text: Lower headings, introductions and supporting text use the same scale. These are the widest-window sizes.
type-narrow-detail.title: Small styles stay readable on a narrow window.
type-narrow-detail.text: The supporting hierarchy closes up while keeping every style at least 12 px.
consent-services.title: The service list explains what is stored.
consent-services.text: These generic records show the service, provider, data and retention information that accompanies the choices. External media stays off until accepted.
text-image-start.title: The picture can come before the text.
text-image-start.text: The image moves to the start while the text and action keep the same rhythm.
card-person-unplated.title: Card can introduce people without a plate.
card-person-unplated.text: The picture defines the opening; the name, role and description inherit their surrounding Surface.
form-brand.title: The form can use the brand Surface.
form-brand.text: Text, borders, errors and native controls follow the surrounding context. Radio and checkbox controls retain their intended light scheme.
form-more.title: Other fields and choices use familiar controls.
form-more.text: Phone, date and number fields sit alongside radio buttons and checkboxes. Each control keeps a visible label.
form-choices.title: Form makes choices explicit.
form-choices.text: Radio buttons ask for one answer. Checkboxes allow an independent choice, with a visible label for each option.
ramps.title: Each colour has ten steps.
ramps.text: Tints, accents and deep shades come from the chosen colours. The same step numbers carry the same jobs in every ramp.
contrast-light.title: Light mode passes every contrast check.
contrast-dark.title: Dark mode passes every contrast check.
contrast-light.text: Text and button labels need 4.5:1. Large text and essential interface marks need 3:1. Each cell states the ratio and the level it meets.
contrast-dark.text: The same checks run again in dark mode. Backgrounds and foregrounds change together; the contrast targets stay the same.
contrast.summary: {count} combinations checked in this mode. All pass. The full list, including states, lives in the design file.
contrast.failed: {count} combinations checked in this mode. Review failures in the design file.
type-comparison.title: The same scale at both window sizes.
type-comparison.text: Left: the narrowest window. Right: the widest. Each row uses the same words at its actual size; aligned rows show how the hierarchy grows.
labels.small.role: Captions, field help and supporting notes.
layout.margin-range: Side-margin setting: {value}. The wide rail sets the margins shown above.
shape.card.text: Larger objects use the card radius.
shape.panel.text: A fine boundary separates a panel from its surroundings.
shadow.settings.words: The shadows are {strength}, with {hardness}, {angle} and {elevation} elevation.
headers.title: Three arrangements use the same header.
headers.text: A, B and C change the position of identity, navigation and actions. Each uses the full window width.
hero-full-picture.title: The opening can sit on a full picture.
hero-full-picture.text: The picture-dark Surface supplies a tested overlay and readable roles over the whole image.
next.intro: A short review now gives the work a clear direction.
next.1.title: Look through it
next.1.text: Consider the colours, typography and the way the components work together.
next.2.title: Approve or comment
next.2.text: Approve the direction, or point to the pages and details you would like to change.
next.3.title: Build from the decisions
next.3.text: Agreed changes go into the design file. The approved system then guides implementation.
